name: count_vertices
description: Counts total vertices in selected objects.

name: rename_object
description: Renames the active object.

name: select_hard_edges
description: Selects all sharp edges in the active mesh.

name: detect_ngons
description: Finds faces with more than four sides in the selected meshes.

name: triangulate_ngons
description: Triangulates every n-gon in the selected meshes.

name: detect_nonplanar_faces
description:
Finds quads and n-gons whose vertices don't lie on one plane.

threshold_deg: how far (in degrees) a vertex may bend out of the face's plane.

name: triangulate_nonplanar_faces
description: Triangulates every non-planar face in the selected meshes.

name: detect_intersecting_meshes
description: Finds faces where separate selected meshes intersect each other.

name: detect_over_triangle_budget
description:
Finds meshes whose triangle count exceeds a budget.

max_tris: the maximum number of triangles allowed per mesh.

name: detect_unapplied_transforms
description:
Finds meshes whose scale isn't 1, or whose rotation isn't 0.

check_rotation: also require rotation to be applied, not just scale.

name: apply_transforms
description:
Applies scale (and rotation) on meshes with unapplied transforms.

Skips mirrored meshes and meshes that share data with other objects.

name: detect_negative_scale
description:
Finds meshes mirrored with a negative scale.

To fix by hand: apply scale, then Mesh > Normals > Recalculate Outside.

name: detect_off_center_pivots
description:
Finds meshes whose origin isn't at the bottom centre of their bounds.

tolerance_m: how far (in metres) the origin may be from the bottom centre.

name: move_pivots_to_bottom_center
description:
Moves each flagged mesh's origin to the bottom centre without moving the mesh.

Skips meshes with children or shared mesh data.

name: detect_wrong_unit_scale
description:
Checks the scene's unit scale against what the target engine expects.

scale_length: the expected Unit Scale (1.0 means 1 Blender unit = 1 metre).

name: set_unit_scale
description: Sets the scene's unit scale to the expected value.

name: detect_missing_uv_maps
description: Finds meshes with no UV map at all.

name: detect_missing_lightmap_uvs
description:
Finds meshes without a lightmap UV channel, or whose lightmap UVs leave 0–1.

channel: index of the lightmap UV map (Unreal uses 1, the second map).

name: detect_missing_textures
description: Finds Image Texture nodes with no image assigned, or whose file is missing.

name: detect_color_space_issues
description: Finds data maps (normal, roughness, metallic) set to sRGB, and colour maps set to Non-Color.

name: fix_color_spaces
description: Sets each flagged image to the colour space its role needs.

name: detect_invalid_texture_sizes
description:
Finds textures that aren't power-of-two sized, or exceed a maximum size.

power_of_two: require both dimensions to be powers of two.
max_size: the largest allowed width or height, in pixels.

name: detect_unused_material_slots
description: Finds material slots no face uses, and empty slots that faces do use.

name: remove_unused_material_slots
description: Removes slots no face uses. Empty slots that faces use need a material assigned by hand.

name: detect_default_names
description: Finds meshes still using Blender's default names (Cube.001, Plane, …).

name: detect_invalid_name_characters
description:
Finds object and material names with characters the target doesn't allow.

pattern: regular expression every name must match.

name: fix_invalid_names
description: Replaces invalid characters in flagged object and material names with underscores.

name: detect_missing_name_prefix
description:
Finds render meshes missing a required name prefix. Collision meshes are ignored.

prefix: the prefix every render mesh name must start with.

name: add_name_prefix
description: Adds the prefix to flagged meshes and renames their collision meshes to match.

name: detect_invalid_collision_meshes
description: Finds UCX_ collision meshes that don't match a render mesh name, or aren't convex.

name: detect_excess_bone_influences
description:
Finds vertices weighted to more deforming bones than the engine supports.

max_influences: the most bones allowed to influence one vertex.
